question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

Our university is __affiliated __with various institutes all over the world.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"affiliated"** means officially attached or connected to an organization. (सम्बद्ध)

 
 
• **Example:** The hospital is affiliated with a leading medical school.
 
 
 
• **"Allied"** refers to being joined or united in a common purpose or by shared interests. (मित्र)
 
 
• **Example:** The two companies are allied in their commitment to sustainable practices.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that "affiliated" is synonymous with "allied".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Disparate** (विभिन्न): Essentially different in kind; not allowing comparison.

 
 
• **Example:** The two cultures were so utterly disparate that she found it hard to adapt.
 
 
 
• **Diverse** (विविध): Showing a great deal of variety; very different.
 
 
• **Example:** The university offers a diverse range of courses.
 
 
 
• **Unlike** (असमान): Different from; not similar to.
 
 
• **Example:** Unlike his brother, he is very outgoing and sociable.
